title: Q-DEPROT-dependabot: add the Dependabot entries for every npm and pip manifest (protected path)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every checks run (probe)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation deprot --strict
**Status:** closed

DEPROT-1: `doctrine/protected/dependabot.yml` is the full `.github/dependabot.yml` that covers every manifest in `doctrine/deprot.json`. A model branch cannot edit `.github/dependabot.yml` (worker-gate deny list). Protected-change reason: dependency rot is watched by a bot only if every manifest has an entry. When it lands, empty `doctrine/deprot.json` baseline in the same change.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:31:14Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
